reviews.review:
Score: 8/10 (reviewing after completing game, some was played in offline mode and hours didn't log; took about 7ish-8ish hours)

A fantastic retro-style shooter straight out of the late 2000's. To me, it feels like high school and college when I was playing games like the Gears of War trilogy on my Xbox 360. Runs like a dream, always entertained, and didn't overstay it's welcome. The ending was fantastic as well. Great Warhammer 40k vibes - can't wait for the sequel in 2024!

Not sure I can recommend, the base game shows a lot of promise though slightly repetitive at times, the difficulty however is so inconsistent that I'm not sure anyone on the dev team played the game through fully on each one.

I picked hard because it seemed to offer a challenge and hopefully would've kept me engaged in the gameplay, and sometimes it did, other times however it would feel like I was playing on easy and other times it was like the level hadn't even been played through a single time by any dev, because how could it have made its way into the game?
Near the end of the game I as soft locked into a mission where I needed a certain build (I imagine) to succeed but I literally did not have the ability to change to it as the save point didn't go far back enough to give me the option. As it is, I was expected to fight a number of enemies at long distance for a long time, without any cover or chance to regen armour, stuck using a melee weapon that stopped me from using my two most powerful ranged weapons. The only way I could've prepared for this was knowing that it was coming up and deliberately choosing the melee weapon that lets me use more ranged ones, however I didn't so I couldn't.

This is just one of quite a few problems that I encountered with this game, although it hasn't stopped me from wanting to play the upcoming Space Marine 2, because the majority of these issues come from it being an older game with a somewhat inattentive dev team at times.

Pros:
+Suprising good GFX for a 12 year old game.
+Decent game with with simple mechanics but a lot of action.
+Short game. Main campaign is 10h at most.

Cons:
-Instead of doubling its default price, which happened recently, Sega should really be giving this away for free as a form of promotion ahead of the release of SM2.

Suggestion:
Perhaps think twice before supporting a company that uses dodgy sales practices.
Not really sure if you can expect to get much out of the online component of this 12 year old title.

Decent game, worth getting but only if the price is €5 or less.
